Is it smuggling if it's technically legal?
A memory smuggler has detailed how he gets export-controlled HBM chips from South Korea into China using a loophole. According to The Information, the smuggler owns a chip design firm that build cheap, low-performing processors that fall under the U.S. and South Korea’s export controls. They are then paired with expensive HBM from Samsung and SK hynix, that, on their own, are banned for export to China. But because export control rules only look at the performance of the server processor and not at the other components attached to it, this allows the HBM chips attached inside them to slip under the radar and make their way into China.
It’s not a risk-free operation, though. Once the mediocre processors with high-end memory chips land in Hong Kong and are smuggled across the border into Shenzhen in the luggage of commuters that cross between the two regions daily, they end up in workshops where technicians heat up the boards to soften the solder, gingerly lift the crucial memory chips, and discard the rest of the components. Despite having a high failure rate, the high price of HBM chips makes the procedure quite lucrative.

articles.summary:
A satellite built by the German startup Orbital Matter 3D-printed a half-meter long beam out of a custom plastic material, in what executives called a first for a free-flying spacecraft in orbit, and a step toward constructing large structures in space.
The company’s small satellite, Replicator 2, was launched on a SpaceX rideshare mission this summer, with four of the company’s 3D printers onboard. Each printer can create a rigid, cylindrical beam by extruding coils of resin that are cured by an ultraviolet light, which the company analogizes to cement and water.
This technology matters because future spacecraft will need to be larger in order to generate more electrical power and radiate a more heat into the vacuum of space, particularly if they’re going to serve as orbital data centers. But they’ll still need to fit into the tight confines of the fairing on top of the rocket that carries them into orbit. If spacecraft are able to construct their own structures in orbit, the power and heat-dissipation challenges may get a lot easier to solve.
“Replicator 2 is the first proof that we can simply build the array in space, at whatever size the mission demands,” said Jakub Stojek, CEO and co-founder of Orbital Matter. The company is partnering with the European Space Agency and Thales Alenia, a leading European satellite builder, with which it collaborated on Replicator 2.

Attackers remotely changed the settings on refrigeration controls at supermarkets in Belgium, Sweden, Estonia and other European countries overnight into Monday, November 2, warming fridges and freezers.
No chain reported more than several dozen affected stores, and some had to throw away chilled and frozen food or take it off the shelf. Danfoss, a Danish maker of refrigeration controls, said its products were involved, as they were three weeks earlier when attackers hit hundreds of French supermarkets.
No one had claimed the attacks by Monday night, and it was not known whether they were linked to the attack in France.
Refrigeration controls are computers that run a store's fridges and freezers. They can be connected to the internet, allowing refrigeration contractors to monitor them and fix faults remotely.
In Belgium, attackers switched cooling units into defrost mode, Stephan Moelans, chief executive of the refrigeration contractor Sabcobel, told Belgian media. Defrost mode is meant to clear ice, but in these attacks it made the units heat up instead of keeping food cold. Sabcobel manages refrigeration systems for the Delhaize supermarket chain.
In other cases, the temperature setting was raised. An ICA store in Sjöbo, in southern Sweden, said its fridges and freezers had been set to 50°C and that staff were throwing out the affected goods.

On a public repair benchmark, the model outscored Anthropic PBC’s Claude Code and OpenAI Group PBC’s Codex.

To test the model on that repair work, Cogent turned to LiveCVEBench. Researchers at Harbin Institute of Technology and Kuaishou Technology built the benchmark from vulnerabilities disclosed in recent months and add new ones regularly. VR-1.1 produced a working repair for 57.9% of the benchmark’s 190 tasks. Claude Code and Codex tied at 45.3%.

Es decir, fue en Francia donde se le dedicaron esos abucheos, pero si revisamos la taquilla de la época podemos ver que también allí fue donde recaudó casi la mitad de lo que hizo en Estados Unidos.
Una decepción. Sofia Coppola todavía define así aquel estreno. "Nos quedamos muy frustrados porque le habíamos dedicado muchísimo trabajo, pero la película no tuvo una acogida demasiado cálida". Sin embargo, veinte años después, se ha convertido en una preciosista pieza de culto a reivindicar: aparte de la exposición en Versalles, se estrena el documental 'Making Marie Antoinette', y la prestigiosa editora Criterion publica una edición del film en 4K aprobada por la directora.
Pero... ¿hubo abucheos? La leyenda negra arranca en la Croisette en mayo de 2006. Coppola defiende que aquello se exageró y que los abucheos salieron de un pequeño grupo de periodistas ingleses. En 2006 Roger Ebert calculó que abuchearon cinco personas, quizá diez, mientras muchas otras aplaudían, y recordó que Variety había hablado de un abucheo con acento galo. La biografía que el propio Festival de Cannes mantiene de la directora afirma que la película recibió “una ovación del público”.

Artificial intelligence penetration testing startup Novee Cyber Security Ltd. today added External Surface Testing to its platform so its AI-driven attacks can reach a customer’s entire internet-facing footprint.
External Surface Testing is aimed at the scramble after a critical vulnerability is disclosed, when security teams have to work out which exposed assets are affected and whether any can actually be exploited. Novee argues that attackers see a target as a single environment with many ways in, including forgotten subdomains and staging servers someone left exposed.
Conventional external attack surface management products catalog a company’s exposed assets and score them by severity. Netta Rager Dan, vice president of product at Novee, said those products “show you what’s exposed, but don’t give you the full picture of real risk.” In the company’s telling, security staff are left to validate long lists of exposures on their own.
Novee’s version needs nothing more than a domain name to get started. From there the software works outward the way an outside attacker would, and it keeps track of what it learns about each asset and service as it goes. A newly disclosed vulnerability gets run against a customer’s live systems to see whether anyone could actually exploit it.

articles.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows | TechCrunch

Stuck in years-long lines for grid connections and new turbines, some AI data centers are making their own electricity with converted jet engines, the New York Times reported Tuesday.
The engines, pulled from retired aircraft and rebuilt to burn natural gas, aren’t anyone’s idea of a permanent power plant. But they’re another sign of how far power supply has fallen behind the AI buildout.
For companies stuck in those lines, the main draw of converted jet engines is how quickly the engines can be up and running. “It’s all about getting power as fast as possible,” Rystad Energy analyst Audun Martinsen told the Times. With jet-powered units, “they can have a data center running in 24 months,” he said.
Hooking up 100 megawatts to the grid in Northern Virginia, by comparison, takes about seven years, according to the International Energy Agency. Most power capacity is expected to come on by 2031, an executive at Mitsubishi Power, one of the world’s top makers of power generation equipment, told Bloomberg last week.
In some cases, these delays are already costing some data center operators business. Last month, Microsoft pulled out as the anchor customer for Nscale’s data center in Loughton, England, after the local utility said it couldn’t deliver enough power until the early to mid-2030s.

Uma operação conjunta de empresas de tecnologia e da polícia japonesa derrubou a infraestrutura de uma botnet formada majoritariamente por TV boxes. A rede tinha 1,3 milhão de dispositivos Android em mais de 200 países, incluindo o Brasil.
A investigação foi conduzida pelo Google, Lumen, Human Security, Plume, Synthient e TrendAI em colaboração com a Agência Nacional de Polícia do Japão. Em comunicado, o Google explica que o malware XCPE foi desenvolvido e operado intencionalmente pela fabricante chinesa Videostrong para obter ganhos financeiros.
A Videostrong fabrica TV boxes, projetores e outros aparelhos Android para diferentes marcas. Segundo a investigação, o XCPE era incorporado ao firmware antes mesmo de esses produtos chegarem às mãos dos consumidores.
Ao se conectarem à internet, os dispositivos se comunicavam com servidores controlados pelos operadores da rede. O Google afirma que a Videostrong vendia acesso aos aparelhos comprometidos para outros grupos, que podiam instalar módulos adicionais de malware. Os dispositivos eram usados principalmente para fraudes publicitárias e redes de proxy residencial.

A Russia-aligned threat actor known as Gorbag has been observed using simple information stealer malware in attacks targeting Ukrainian organizations.
"Active since at least February 2025, the group has focused exclusively on Ukrainian targets, with a clear preference for law enforcement and justice entities, local administrations near the front line, and the defense sector," ESET researcher Damien Schaeffer said in a report shared with The Hacker News.
The activity shares overlaps with a cluster tracked by the Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) under the moniker UAC-0226 and by Trend Micro as SHADOW-EARTH-066. Gorbag is known to be active since at least February 2025.
A key tool in the threat actor's malware arsenal is GIFTEDCROOK, a C/C++ stealer that facilitates the theft of sensitive data from web browsers like Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Mozilla Firefox, such as cookies, browsing history, and authentication data.
Earlier this June, Trend Micro also attributed the adversary to attacks weaponizing a now-patched vulnerability in WinRAR (CVE-2025-8088) to trigger a DLL sideloading chain responsible for executing GIFTEDCROOK.
Stealer malware deployed by Gorbag is also equipped to harvest VPN configurations and documents of interest, raising the possibility that it may be acting as an initial access broker that hands off stolen data to other threat actors, who then can conduct post-exploitation activity of their own.

Joyce Zhang sees this every week. A former product manager at Stripe, she now works as a dating coach in San Francisco, charges $5,000 a month and takes only tech founders as clients. articles.title: Unos científicos italianos viajaron a Etiopía a estudiar monos y volvieron con una inverosímil historia de amor entre un burro y un toro

En un pasto comunal de Debre Libanos, en las tierras altas de Etiopía, un burro llamado Patroclo busca a un toro llamado Achille en mitad del prado. Se le acerca y le toca con el hocico en el costado. Pasan cosas, aparecen terceros en discordia. Hay peleas, algún mordisco. Pero al final, juntos otra vez, el toro monta al asno y se queda lamiéndolo.
Pero esa escena, grabada en vídeo con otras tantas, no era un hecho aislado. Lo que los investigadores italianos acaban de encontrar es una relación que desafía lo que sabemos sobre conducta animal: dos machos de familias distintas que, con vacas y burras a unos pocos metros, se buscaban una y otra vez.
Lo que uno encuentra cuando va a estudiar monos. El equipo de Elisabetta Palagi, etóloga de la Universidad de Pisa, trabaja desde hace años en esa zona de Etiopía estudiando cómo resuelven sus conflictos los geladas, unos monos endémicos de la región. Un día, sin esperarlo, vieron la primera monta y, claro, les llamó la atención.
A partir de ese momento, siguieron de cerca a la pareja: tenemos un registro minucioso de acercamientos, caricias, montas y peleas.
Los pastores de la zona, curiosamente, se reían de los investigadores. Como explicaba Palagi, "lo que para nosotros era una observación inesperada era, evidentemente, una escena familiar para ellos".

Observability company groundcover Inc. today added Autonomous Infrastructure to its platform in beta to rightsize the processor and memory requests automatically on customers’ Kubernetes workloads based on how each workload behaves in production.
The technology comes from Kubernetes resource optimization startup Wand Cloud Ltd., which groundcover acquired in September.
The release is aimed at the processor and memory requests Kubernetes has engineers set for each workload up front, usually before it has handled any real traffic, and groundcover said most teams seldom return to those numbers. When one is set too low, the first sign is often a service throwing out-of-memory errors. Padding that goes unused ends up on the monthly cloud bill.
Because the groundcover sensor has been collecting production history all along, a customer on a supported version can open Autonomous Infrastructure for the first time without installing anything and find the data the feature needs already in place. Requested processor and memory for each workload appear next to actual usage. Estimated monthly savings sit beside a count of under-provisioned workloads, and a chart tracks over time how much of the potential saving has been realized.

Why advanced packaging will determine whether CPO can scale for the AI era
Co-packaged optics technology is often described as a photonics breakthrough. But its commercial success will depend just as much on advanced packaging: how optical and electronic components are integrated, connected, protected, and manufactured repeatedly at scale.
Artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented demand for computing power and data movement. As processors become more powerful, the electrical connections that move data between them are becoming a growing constraint. They consume power, create heat and can limit how quickly information moves through an AI system.
Co-packaged optics (CPO) offers a new approach. It brings optical engines much closer to the processors and switches they serve, shortening the high-speed electrical path between the processor or switch and the optical engine, so data can transition to optical transmission closer to the source. The goal is higher bandwidth, lower interconnect energy per bit, and lower latency.
But a key point about CPO is often overlooked: advanced packaging decisions determine whether silicon photonics can be integrated tightly enough with electronics to work reliably in real-world systems. Here’s why:
1. CPO is really a heterogeneous integration challenge
A CPO system must combine components that were historically designed, manufactured and packaged separately. Photonic integrated circuits, electronic chips, interconnects, fibers and supporti…

articles.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models' identity | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Anthropic is working on an open source system to verify which AI model produced a given output, according to a blog post published Tuesday. The system, called FlashProve, is built to provide what researchers call “provable inference” — a cryptographic proof, essentially a mathematical guarantee, that a given output came from a specific model. It’s meant to let users confirm that the answer they received really came from the model they think they’re using.
Similar to cryptographic email signatures that let recipients confirm a message really came from its claimed sender, FlashProve would be robust against impostors attempting to disguise one model as another, even when the impostor is the lab that built and runs the model. In particular, the researchers note that the system could be used to prevent an AI company from secretly swapping in a cheaper model to cut costs, or a more expensive model to inflate its performance results.
FlashProve could also be used to verify claims by third parties that a specific task was done by an advanced model. “A developer might claim that their software library was scanned for vulnerabilities by a frontier cybersecurity model, or a company might claim that its business plan was given the go-ahead by an appropriate model,” the researchers write. “How can a user verify these claims?”
To work, the system requires AI labs to publish a “fingerprint” of each model they release that can later be matched to specific outputs and verified cryptographical…

You’re spending too much time and effort on exposures attackers may never exploit, while higher-risk exposures sit, waiting in the queue. Gartner®’s report on exposure prioritization states that fewer than 10% of vulnerabilities are exploited, yet most are treated as urgent. The report also argues that CVSS scores alone do not predict actual exploitation or business impact.
Gartner predicts that by 2028, organizations that prioritize exposures using threat intelligence, asset context, exploitability modeling, and security control validation will reduce breach likelihood by at least 70% compared to their peers relying primarily on CVSS-based vulnerability prioritization. Severity-based prioritization made sense. Then it didn't.

Enterprises face tens of thousands of new vulnerabilities a year across cloud, SaaS, identity, and supply chain modalities, and AI has compressed time-to-exploit from weeks or months to hours.

articles.title: What does "Wi-Fi" stand for?
articles.summary:
Here's the story behind it
Wi-Fi: the name that never stood for anything
Millions of people and even plenty of tech textbooks will tell you that Wi-Fi is short for "Wireless Fidelity." It isn't. Wi-Fi is not an acronym, and the name doesn't mean anything at all.
The story starts in the late 1990s. The IEEE published the 802.11 wireless networking standard in 1997, and the faster 802.11b revision was finalized in 1999, which topped out at 11 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band.
The tech worked, but nobody was going to ask for "IEEE 802.11b" compatibility at a store. That's when the Wireless Ethernet Compatibility Alliance (WECA) started to look for something consumers could remember, so in 1999 they hired branding agency Interbrand.
Interbrand is known for coming up with commercial names like Prozac, Nintendo "Wii," and Compaq. It pitched a shortlist of 10 candidates, and the alliance picked "Wi-Fi," a deliberate play on "Hi-Fi," the decades-old shorthand for high-fidelity audio. The name carried the right associations of quality and ease, without describing anything technical. Interbrand also designed the yin-yang style Wi-Fi logo.
But what about the "Wireless Fidelity" confusion?
Early on, some alliance board members worried that a name with no meaning would confuse people, so they attached a tagline: "The Standard for Wireless Fidelity."
According to Phil Belanger, a founding member of the alliance, the tagline appeared on everything for roughly a year. He later called it a mistake th…

articles.title: Red Hat Patches 9.8-Rated Linux TCP RCE Flaw While Ubuntu Releases Fixes for Testing
articles.summary:
Fixed kernels for a use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP code are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8, 9, and 10, while Ubuntu's fixes for its three newest long-term-support releases remain in its opt-in testing channel with no date for a regular update.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-98432, can be reached by a remote, unauthenticated attacker and can lead to remote code execution, Red Hat and Canonical said.
The Linux kernel's own CVE team rates the flaw 9.8 out of 10 on the CVSS scale. Red Hat, which initially rated it Moderate at 5.9, has raised its score to 9.8 and now calls it Critical. The bug has been present since Linux 4.4, and the upstream fix landed in October.
What the Flaw Is
When a server accepts an IPv4 TCP connection, the kernel passes IP options from the incoming request to the new socket without copying them. If the client retransmits its connection request while another processor still reads those options, the kernel can read memory it has already freed.
An attacker triggers the race by sending connection requests that carry IPv4 Record Route or Timestamp options to any listening TCP port. No login is needed. IPv6 is not affected on the main path.
Red Hat shipped RHSA-2026:93414 (RHEL 8), RHSA-2026:93412 (RHEL 9), and RHSA-2026:93413 (RHEL 10) on November 1. A reboot is needed after installing the update.

A Microsoft segue tentando otimizar o Windows 11 para máquinas com apenas 8 GB de RAM. Uma nova atualização reduz o consumo de memória e diminui a necessidade de recorrer ao SSD ou HD quando vários programas estão abertos ao mesmo tempo.
Segundo Pavan Davuluri, chefe da divisão de Windows e Dispositivos, os ajustes deixaram algumas interações do sistema até 20% mais rápidas e melhoraram em até 40% a alternância entre tarefas pesadas nos testes da empresa.
As tentativas de otimização no Windows, que é constantemente criticado por isso, ocorrem num momento de crise na indústria de componentes eletrônicos. Com a expansão de data centers para empresas de inteligência artificial, o foco do setor de semicondutores tem sido alimentá-los, destinando maior parte da capacidade produtiva para chips usados nos servidores.
Enquanto isso, peças chegam ao consumidor cada vez mais caras: o preço de memórias DDR5 saltou cerca de 500% entre 2025 e 2026, limitando a montagem de PCs com mais RAM.
Boa parte das mudanças está na forma como o Windows administra o esgotamento de memória disponível. Quando a RAM fica cheia, o sistema precisa transferir parte dos dados temporários para SDD ou HD, que são mais lentos e diminuem o desempenho na execução de programas.

articles.title: Vizio smart TVs are ignoring tracking opt-outs, continue to send data even when sitting idle
articles.summary:
A hot potato: Vizio paid $2.2 million to settle charges that its smart TVs had quietly tracked what was playing on 11 million screens back in 2017. As part of that deal, the company had to start asking owners for permission first. A new study, however, suggests that telling a current Vizio TV "no" doesn't change much, at least as far as its network traffic goes.
For the study, researchers at Northeastern University tested 12 smart TVs from 10 manufacturers. Together, those sets run the eight operating systems behind roughly 95% of US smart TVs. Every viewing scenario – antenna, HDMI, streaming apps and more – ran 30 times with automatic content recognition (ACR) turned on. Each one then ran 30 more times after the researchers opted out through the TV's own settings.
Vizio's SmartCast platform came out looking the worst. After the researchers opted out, the Vizio TV kept sending just as much data as before to an Amazon Kinesis server the team linked to ACR. That happened in every single run, even while the set sat idle on its home screen.
By comparison, only four platforms – LG's webOS, Fire TV, VIDAA and Sony's Google TV – fully went quiet after opting out. But the Samsung set continued sending ACR-like traffic in all 30 tests of the company's own streaming service. Roku's opt-out, meanwhile, doesn't cover The Roku Channel at all.
Still, the Vizio and Samsung traffic is encrypted, so the researchers couldn't see what was actually inside it. That's why they stop short of sayin…

articles.title: cPGuard Update Channel Hijacked to Backdoor Linux Servers and Collect Password Hashes
articles.summary:
An attacker broke into the update system of the cPGuard security tool on November 2 and used it to send a malicious script to customers' Linux servers.
The script installed a backdoor and collected password hashes and other sensitive files from servers that ran it, cPGuard maker OPSSHIELD said in an advisory. The attacker has since taken some of that data.
cPGuard 5.88.25 and later versions remove the backdoor and the files the script left. Credentials the script copied may still work after the update, so any server that may have run the script also needs new passwords and keys.
At 02:06 UTC, the attacker, who has not been identified, used compromised credentials to get into cPGuard's update system. The script went out in cPGuard versions 5.88.12 through 5.88.19.
The attack was detected within 12 hours of those versions going out, according to OPSSHIELD. The company has cleared its infrastructure credentials and stopped the script from reaching more servers. It is still investigating how the attacker got the credentials.
OPSSHIELD has not said how many servers installed one of these versions. Servers check for updates at intervals, so some may not have run the script.
Admins can check whether a server installed an affected version by searching its update log:
grep 'Successfully updated' /opt/cpguard/logs/install_log

Tuesday, November 3rd 2026
Massive Four-GPU RX 470 Card Surfaces, Probably Built for Crypto Miners
X user GOK has shared photos of a huge red graphics card that carries four Polaris GPUs on a single PCB, jokingly asking whether it might be the biggest PCIe graphics card in the world. The four GPUs sit in a 2x2 layout, and each one appears to be surrounded by eight GDDR5 memory chips, which would mean 8 GB per GPU and a gigantic 32 GB across the board. According to GOK, a sticker on the card identifies it as a quad RX 470, which would work out to 8,192 stream processors in total. Feeding all of that are four 8-pin power connectors, while the only display output is a single HDMI port. A second photo shows the card lying next to a motherboard, and it's noticeably bigger than the board itself.
The PCB does carry an AMD logo next to a "DYII-XQ570 V1.0" marking, but it looks like AMD may not have built this one. GOK pointed out that the card has no board OPN (part number) and that the marking doesn't follow AMD's official format, adding that small factories in China sometimes put the AMD logo on their own designs. He also identified the PCIe switch as a PI7C9X2G, a PCIe 2.0 part, and thinks the card was likely made by one of those factories for crypto miners. He hasn't tested it yet, since he doesn't have a heatsink for it. Multi-GPU Polaris mining boards aren't new either, as Sapphire had a dual RX 570 mining card with 16 GB and a single HDMI port back in 2021.

articles.title: Google Warns LLMjacking Attacks Are Costing Some Enterprises Up to $1 Million in Cloud Charges
articles.summary:
Google on Monday warned that threat actors are hijacking enterprise access to Large Language Models (LLMs) to fraudulently leverage expensive computing resources and AI services.
The tactic is called LLMjacking, a form of resource hijacking adapted for the LLM era, where an attacker obtains an API key through phishing, source code leaks, misconfigured environments, or exposed client-side code to gain unauthorized access to an organization's LLM accounts, while the legitimate owner covers the consumption costs.
Such attacks have a wide geographical footprint, with impacted entities located in North America, South America, and Asia Pacific across the financial services, retail, technology, and transportation sectors.
"Unlike the gradual resource consumption associated with cryptojacking, LLMJacking can generate large spikes in fraudulent cloud charges in a matter of hours," Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant said in a report shared with The Hacker News.
"Across individual incidents, we observed fraudulent charges associated with resource consumption exceeding $100,000 USD in a single day, with cumulative charges at some organizations reaching $1 million USD before access was revoked."

Proton VPN already sits among the best VPN services we've tested, climbing to third place in our latest round of re-testing. Anything that tightens up its iOS app is good news for privacy-minded iPhone owners.

While CVE-2026-116606 only affects Email Security Gateway, CVE-2026-111560 impacts the following Barracuda products -
- Email Security Gateway
- Load Balancer Application Delivery Controller
- Message Archiver
- WAF Control Center
- Web Application Firewall
- Web Security Gateway
"Successful exploitation requires an attacker to have access to the administrative interface of an affected product," Barracuda said. "If exploited in combination, these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to bypass authorization controls and obtain root access to the device."
Barracuda said that organizations that do not expose their administrative interfaces to the internet are less vulnerable to the attack path, urging customers to follow the steps below -
- Restrict access to administrative interfaces to trusted internal networks

articles.title: José Luis Gómez-Pardo, CEO de Nixval: "La factura de agua de nuestro centro de datos es literalmente la del consumo de los baños"
articles.summary:
Pocas infraestructuras tecnológicas han causado tanta controversia durante los últimos años como los centros de datos. Aunque su existencia precede a la inteligencia artificial, ha sido desde su auge cuando han cobrado una inusitada relevancia pública. Las ingentes necesidades de cómputo de los LLM han provocado que las grandes tecnológicas desplieguen enormes cantidades de centros de datos por todo el mundo, España incluida.
Las cifras hablan por sí solas: solo en nuestro país hay más de un centenar de centros de datos construidos o previstos, con un total de 2,9 GW de potencia; a nivel internacional, las cinco grandes tecnológicas estadounidenses gastarán este año unos 900.000 millones de dólares, sin duda la factura más elevada que deja la IA. La descomunal inversión en centros de datos es a día de hoy el factor limitante más claro para la rentabilidad de la IA, fruto de los costes siempre crecientes que representan.
Y en paralelo ha sucedido otra cosa: los centros de datos han sido instrumentalizados políticamente. Al ser poco intensivos en mano de obra, ocupar mucho espacio y consumir mucha energía, su construcción ha despertado recelos tanto en las poblaciones locales como en grupos políticos escépticos del poder de las tecnológicas. Esto ha provocado que los centros de datos sean objeto de una larga, confusa disputa sobre su impacto y beneficios.

articles.title: Binance Reveals How Fake Job Interviews and AI Tool Abuse Led to $6.43 Billion Theft
articles.summary:
Binance on Tuesday said the record-setting theft of $6.43 billion in assets from the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange was the culmination of a "sophisticated, multi-stage campaign" that involved the use of a tampered Homebrew installation and recruitment-themed social engineering attack targeting two of its engineers.
"It was not a single isolated breach or a simple phishing incident," the company said. "The attackers combined a range of techniques, including social engineering by fake recruitment interviews, malicious software downloads, compromised internal AI tooling, endpoint compromise, and an advanced transaction-authorisation method."
The starting point has been traced back to a supply chain attack targeting one of its engineers from the Wallet DevOps team (named "Engineer A"), who downloaded a trojanized Homebrew installer to install a popular artificial intelligence (AI) tool after searching for it on a search engine. The incident occurred in June 2026.
Although Binance said it detected the attack and rotated all related credentials as a precautionary step, the company said information about "Engineer A's role and his related colleagues on our wallet infrastructure team was exposed to the hacker."
The second part of the attack occurred in September 2026, with the threat actor contacting another engineer (named "Engineer B") via a legitimate job-hunting platform by disguising themselves as a Project Director.

articles.title: Elon Musk's xAI installs eight converted jet engines to power Mississippi data center — permits allow 25 percent higher limit for pollutants, concerns raised over carbon monoxide
articles.summary:
Elon Musk's xAI installs eight converted jet engines to power Mississippi data center — permits allow 25 percent higher limit for pollutants, concerns raised over carbon monoxide
Carbon dioxide-spilling converted turbines have been installed in a Mississippi xAI data center despite the known health risks.
Elon Musk's xAI is using eight converted jet engine turbines to power a Mississippi data center. While the generators have the required state-level permission and permits, there remain concerns about the impact they could have on the local environment. The permits allow for a 25% higher limit in pollutants known as volatile organic compounds, but those compounds, paired with the expulsion of carbon monoxide, have environmentalists warning that the use of jet engines to power data centers is a step in the wrong direction. The New York Times reports that the Southern Environmental Law Center has already challenged Mississippi's decision to approve the turbines for use at xAI's data center.
The group argues that xAI has failed to provide guarantees that the jet-powered turbines meet emissions standards for specific pollutants, including formaldehyde. It also accuses xAI of what the report terms the "undercounting" of projected emissions in relation to the data center's power sources. This comes after the same group sued xAI over its use of gas generators without the required permits in an area with more than 100,000 inhabitants.

articles.title: Block shares rise after third-quarter beat and a third straight guidance raise - SiliconANGLE

Block shares rise after third-quarter beat and a third straight guidance raise
Shares of Block Inc. rose more than 7% in late trading today after the payments and financial services company beat third-quarter expectations and raised its full-year guidance for the third straight time.
For the quarter that ended on Sept. 30, Block reported adjusted earnings of $1.13 per share, up from 54 cents in the same quarter of the previous year, on revenue of $6.72 billion, up nearly 10% year-over-year. Analysts were expecting $1.03 per share on revenue of $6.58 billion.
Gross profit grew 22%, to $3.24 billion, and finished ahead of the company’s own guidance. Adjusted operating income almost doubled, to a record $923 million, and the adjusted operating margin rose to 29% of gross profit. Product development spending fell 11% from a year earlier, reflecting the workforce cut Block made in February.
Operating income on an unadjusted basis rose a more modest 5%, to $428 million, held back by $435 million in contingencies, restructuring and other charges. Net income attributable to common stockholders came to $566 million, compared with $462 million a year earlier.
Cash App gross profit grew 27% to $2.07 billion. Monthly transacting actives reached 60 million in September, and Block named Neighborhoods as a key driver after the loyalty network auto-enrolled more than 30,000 Square seller locations in August. articles.title: Olvídate de las sesiones de gimnasio de una hora: "picar" ejercicio a lo largo del día te da una fuerza parecida
articles.summary:
Todos tenemos clara la importancia de hacer ejercicio. Otra cosa es que seamos capaces de reunir suficiente tiempo libre para practicarlo. Lógicamente, la salud es lo primero y deberíamos dedicarle el tiempo que merece, pero por desgracia nuestras rutinas no siempre nos lo permiten. Por eso, hace años que se estudian los beneficios del exercise snacking, una forma de entrenamiento que consiste, básicamente, en cambiar una sesión larga por varias sesiones cortas a lo largo del día. Hasta ahora se habían estudiado mayormente sus efectos cuando se usa para sustituir largos entrenamientos aeróbicos. Sin embargo, un equipo de científicos de la Universidad de Tongji, en China, acaba de demostrar que también es útil con el ejercicio de fuerza.
El experimento. Para la realización de este estudio se contó con 45 voluntarios, todos ellos hombres estudiantes, acostumbrados al ejercicio de fuerza y con edades comprendidas entre los 18 y los 25 años. Se dividieron en tres grupos, uno control y dos experimentales. En los dos grupos experimentales hicieron un entrenamiento de 8 semanas, con tres días de ejercicio semanales. Cada uno de esos días, los del primer grupo hicieron una sola sesión continua de 60 sentadillas, mientras que en el otro grupo experimental hicieron tres bloques espaciados de un minuto de entrenamiento con 20 sentadillas en cada uno. articles.title: Apple advierte de un aumento “sin precedentes” en los precios de los chips de memoria
articles.summary:
Apple enfrenta un escenario cada vez más complejo para conseguir chips de memoria, componentes fundamentales para el funcionamiento de sus dispositivos. La compañía advirtió que los precios de estos semiconductores están aumentando a un ritmo “sin precedentes”, impulsados principalmente por la demanda de los centros de datos que utilizan inteligencia artificial (IA).
La situación ya representa un desafío para el fabricante del iPhone, que debe competir con las grandes empresas tecnológicas por el suministro de estos componentes. Además, el encarecimiento podría afectar sus márgenes de beneficio, incluso después de haber registrado ingresos superiores a los previstos durante su tercer trimestre fiscal.
John Ternus, nuevo director ejecutivo de Apple desde septiembre, abordó el problema durante una teleconferencia con inversores. “Lo que estamos viendo ahora mismo con los precios de la memoria no tiene precedentes”, afirmó. También anticipó que los costos de estos componentes durante el cuarto trimestre del año serían incluso más elevados que en los tres meses anteriores.
La inteligencia artificial impulsa el encarecimiento de la memoria
El aumento de los precios de los chips de memoria está relacionado con la expansión de la infraestructura tecnológica necesaria para desarrollar y ejecutar sistemas de inteligencia artificial. articles.summary:
Le GPS de sa Renault Latitude de 2014 ne permettait pas de changer l’heure sans une carte SD de cartographie officielle. Un chercheur estonien a fini par contourner ces restrictions pour y exécuter ses propres scripts avec les droits d’administrateur.
Rasmus Moorats voulait simplement régler sa voiture à l’heure d’hiver. Son interface TomTom Carminat LIVE lui a pourtant imposé un détour numérique inattendu. Le menu de réglage de l’horloge dépendait en effet de fichiers présents sur la carte SD de navigation, qu’il avait choisi de ne pas récupérer lors de l’achat de la voiture. Le chercheur s’est donc plongé dans le logiciel de l’appareil pour trouver un autre accès. Et force est de constater qu’il est plutôt ingénieux…
Des protections solides, un script trop privilégié
Le GPS embarqué de sa Renault Latitude fonctionne sous une version de Linux adaptée par TomTom (noyau 2.6.28.10). Malgré son âge avancé, plusieurs protections compliquent les modifications par des utilisateurs tiers. Certaines partitions sont en effet en lecture seule ; d’autres utilisent l’option noexec, qui bloque l’exécution directe des programmes qu’elles contiennent.
La carte SD est elle aussi montée avec l’option noexec. Ses fichiers de cartographie sont également liés à son identifiant matériel, ce qui empêche de les utiliser en les copiant simplement sur une autre carte.

Intel 14A moves closer to production as PDK 0.9 becomes available — plans to release PDK 1.0 in the first quarter of 2027
PDK 1.0 due in early 2027.
Intel Foundry last week made available its Intel 14A process design kit (PDK) version 0.9, an important milestone in the development of this next-generation manufacturing technology. The company says that the production node is reaching performance and yield maturity expected at this stage of development, and the results are backed by silicon validation. Intel plans to release PDK 1.0 in the first quarter of 2027, which will validate the technology's readiness for high-volume manufacturing (HVM).
14A PDK v0.9 is here
A process design kit contains transistor models, design rules, and other information that enables chip designers to develop products for a particular manufacturing process using electronic design automation (EDA) tools. The accuracy and quality of the PDK are crucial for modelling how chips will perform once manufactured, and the release of PDK 0.9 is particularly important because it provides customers with a representation of Intel 14A based on actual silicon measurements rather than on theoretical models or simulations. At this stage, customers can proceed with product development with greater confidence that the technology will meet their requirements when it comes to performance and power consumption.

articles.title: CrowdStrike to acquire cybersecurity startups Fiddler AI, Dreadnode for reported $495M - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
CrowdStrike to acquire cybersecurity startups Fiddler AI, Dreadnode for reported $495M
CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. today disclosed plans to buy Fiddler AI Inc. and Dreadnode Inc., two startups that specialize in securing artificial intelligence agents.
The company announced the deals alongside an update to its Falcon Guardian product.
The Wall Street Journal reported that CrowdStrike will spend $495 million on the acquisitions. Fiddler is believed to account for about four-fifths of that sum. The Palo Alto, California-based startup sells a platform that developers use to test their AI agents for risks before launching them. The software spots issues such as malicious AI-generated code and training data leaks.
Fiddler can try different model and configuration combinations to find the one that minimizes an agent’s risk level. If the agent still generates prompts that breach cybersecurity rules, developers can use the platform to study the reasoning workflow that produced them. Fiddler says that its software makes it easier to identify the specific processing step that went wrong and fix it.
Once an agent is in production, Fiddler uses a series of custom models called Centor to block threats. It filters malicious prompts and blocks harmful output. According to the company, Centor adds less than 80 milliseconds of latency to the requests it reviews.

articles.title: Chainstack Reports Production Systems Breach Exposing Customer Data and Password Hashes
articles.summary:
Blockchain infrastructure provider Chainstack on Tuesday disclosed that it was targeted in a cyber attack that allowed an unauthorized party to gain access to some parts of its infrastructure.
The incident is assessed to be part of a large-scale, artificial intelligence (AI)-powered attack campaign that came to light last week.
"An external attacker gained unauthorized access to part of Chainstack's infrastructure through a third-party component," the company said. "We detected the intrusion, cut the access paths, and are hardening our systems."
According to the timeline of events shared by Chainstack, the attacker gained access to a development environment on October 26, 2026, and then escalated their access to break into "some parts of our production environment."
The intrusion was subsequently detected on October 31, 2026, and the attacker's access was cut off that same day, the company noted.
As part of the digital break-in, the threat actor is said to have accessed a database containing customer account information, including organization names, account holder names, the email addresses of organization’s members on Chainstack, and password hashes.
"The attacker also had access to systems holding node credentials," Chainstack said. "We have no evidence they were read, but we are treating them as exposed and ask customers to rotate them."

articles.title: Xbox Loses Its First Chief Operating Officer Mid-Reset
articles.summary:
Tuesday, November 3rd 2026
Xbox Loses Its First Chief Operating Officer Mid-Reset
Helen Chiang, Xbox's first-ever chief operating officer, has left Microsoft just three months after taking on the role. The news comes from a short internal memo by Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma, obtained by The Verge, which simply states that Chiang is leaving the company and thanks her for her years of service. No reason was given, and Xbox's VP of communications, Kari Perez, said the company doesn't discuss individual personnel matters. There's no successor yet either, so Chiang's duties will be split among other Xbox leaders for now, with Sharma promising more details on COO leadership once plans are finalized.
Chiang had been at Microsoft for around 21 years, starting in 2005 and moving to Xbox in 2007, where Sharma credits her with helping build Xbox Live. She later led Mojang and became corporate vice president of the Minecraft franchise in 2020. Sharma created the COO position in July as part of her reset of Xbox, and it came with end-to-end profit and loss responsibility across content, hardware, platform, and services. That same reset includes around 3,200 job cuts by the end of fiscal year 2027, with hundreds of jobs already gone. Losing the executive meant to hold the whole business together this early into the reset probably isn't the kind of stability Xbox was hoping for.

articles.title: Google recibe un revés ante el TJUE por el uso de noticias en Gemini y los medios ganan terreno para reclamar compensaciones
articles.summary:
Una noticia puede llegar a millones de personas sin que todas ellas visiten el medio que la publicó. Durante años, los buscadores han servido como intermediarios entre quienes producen información y quienes quieren encontrarla, proporcionando un flujo de visitas que ayuda a sostener el negocio de la prensa digital. Sin embargo, la inteligencia artificial ha introducido un nuevo escenario: los usuarios pueden obtener respuestas directamente, sin necesidad de acceder a las fuentes originales. Para el lector puede resultar cómodo, pero para los medios plantea una cuestión de fondo sobre el valor de sus contenidos y cómo se remunera su trabajo.
Esa tensión acaba de trasladarse a la justicia europea. Este martes, 3 de noviembre, el abogado general del Tribunal de Justicia de la Unión Europea (TJUE), Maciej Szpunar, ha concluido que Gemini puede vulnerar los derechos de los editores cuando recupera y reutiliza sus publicaciones para generar respuestas en determinadas circunstancias. Su interpretación supone un revés para Google y abre una posible vía para futuras reclamaciones económicas por parte de los medios. Sin embargo, hay un matiz importante: se trata de unas conclusiones no vinculantes, por lo que todavía corresponde al tribunal pronunciarse mediante una sentencia.

Applied Compute Inc., a fast-growing provider of artificial intelligence infrastructure, has raised $350 million in funding at a $3.25 billion valuation.

The group takes on tasks such as creating quality evaluations for newly developed models.
The software stack that AI researchers use to train LLMs usually comprises two main components. One creates multiple copies of the model, assigns a different task to each one and turns the results into training data. The other component uses that training data to refine the LLM’s weights. The two components usually run synchronously, which means that each one has to wait for the other to complete its work before launching.

Según Kaspersky, el ataque se detectó a comienzos de 2026 contra organizaciones diplomáticas de Asia Central. La empresa de seguridad lo atribuyó, con confianza moderada, al grupo de hackers APT41 y presentó la investigación en la conferencia Security Analyst Summit 2026, en Bali, Indonesia.
BlackX es un bootkit: un programa malicioso que se ejecuta antes de que arranque Windows, cuando el sistema todavía no tiene activas muchas de sus defensas. Kaspersky lo describe como una versión modernizada de BlackLotus, un software que se vendía en la web oscura desde 2022.
Para instalarlo, los atacantes ya habían entrado en las redes internas de las víctimas y obtenido permisos de administrador. El bootkit funciona como un mecanismo de permanencia invisible y prolongada en los equipos.
Una falla de 2022 que sigue abierta
BlackX aprovecha “Baton Drop”, una falla del gestor de arranque de Windows registrada como CVE-2022-21894, que permite saltarse Secure Boot. Esta función verifica que, al encender la computadora, solo se ejecute software de confianza. Según el medio especializado Ars Technica, Microsoft corrigió la falla en 2022.

The high-severity vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS score: 8.1), is a case of Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition that could be exploited to achieve arbitrary code execution on affected servers. Patches for the flaw were released late last month.
"WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window," CISA said. "This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades."
Details of the flaw emerged last week when Wordfence said exploiting the vulnerability does not require an account on the site. That said, it does require an attacker to exploit a brief window during a complete Core update that could allow unauthenticated code execution.
During the first 21 hours after public disclosure, the WordPress security company said it recorded more than 18,500 requests targeting staged "setup-config.php" installer paths. As of writing, 12,632 attacks attempting to exploit the flaw have been blocked in the last 24 hours.

articles.summary:
Un equipo de la compañía australiana Cortical Labs logró conectar neuronas humanas vivas en un perro robot para controlarlo para guiarlo hasta un objetivo, como primera prueba.
El sistema no es un cerebro completo ni un animal híbrido. Se trata de un cultivo de neuronas humanas conectado a un chip, capaz de recibir y enviar señales eléctricas que terminan convertidas en movimiento real.
Cómo lograron que un perro robot se conecte a neuronas humanas
Las neuronas se generan a partir de células madre pluripotentes inducidas y crecen directamente sobre un chip de silicio equipado con electrodos microscópicos.
Esos electrodos permiten una comunicación en dos direcciones. Por un lado, envían estímulos eléctricos a las células. Por otro, registran la actividad que esas neuronas producen como respuesta.
Un programa informático interpreta esa señal y la traduce en órdenes concretas para el robot. Así, el perro mecánico puede desplazarse hacia el punto indicado dentro de un mapa simple.
La clave del sistema es el bucle de retroalimentación: el dispositivo informa a las neuronas sobre el resultado de cada movimiento, y esa información ajusta la próxima estimulación. De esta forma, la red biológica va encontrando patrones que le permiten dirigir a la máquina con mayor precisión.
Según Brett Kagan, cofundador y director ejecutivo de Cortical Labs, el perro robótico funciona como una prueba de concepto. “El perro robótico es una demostración simple de cómo el progreso en los sistemas bioló…

articles.title: Unos científicos han construido una Tierra virtual sin vida para saber si hay vida en otros planetas
articles.summary:
A la hora de buscar vida extraterrestre, tenemos un solo referente: la Tierra. Nuestro planeta es el único del que conocemos en profundidad su composición y características, desde el núcleo hasta la atmósfera, pero también es el único planeta del que tenemos certeza de la existencia de vida. Por eso, si queremos encontrar algo parecido más allá de nuestras fronteras, también es importante mirar hacia dentro. Para lograrlo, un equipo de científicos de la Universidad de Washington ha construido una Tierra virtual sin vida. Con ella como modelo, pueden analizar los más de 6.000 exoplanetas que se han encontrado hasta ahora y comprobar si realmente podrían albergar organismos vivos en su interior.
Una Tierra virtual más completa. En realidad, esta no es la primera Tierra virtual que se modela. Ya existía una en la que se incluían el núcleo, el manto y la corteza. El nuevo modelo incluye también la atmósfera y la superficie, pues son dos áreas esenciales para estudiar la presencia de vida.
Tierra deshabitada. El modelo que han desarrollado estos científicos abarca la historia de la Tierra desde su formación, hace 4.500 millones de años, hasta un futuro que aún no ha ocurrido, dentro de 500 millones de años. Inicialmente se han tenido en cuenta las características geológicas de la Tierra, sin contemplar la vida. Es muy útil, ya que así se pueden ver las variaciones con respecto a la Tierra habitada. Si cette modification permet d’apporter jusqu’à 400 MW au site, les émissions inquiètent les associations environnementales avec déjà plusieurs procédures en cours.

C’est la société ProEnergy qui les a modifiées pour en faire des générateurs au gaz naturel capables de produire jusqu’à 50 MW chacun avec une puissance combinée de 400 MW. Le permis accordé à xAI pour le centre de données Colossus 2 concerne 41 turbines permanentes pour une puissance totale proche de 1,2 GW. Leur installation est privilégiée car bien plus rapide que les raccordements au réseau demandent des années, en général.

articles.title: Ahora se buscan paseadores de perros robot: pagan hasta 20 dólares la hora

Una empresa emergente de San Francisco publicó este mes una oferta de trabajo poco habitual, se buscan paseadores de perros robóticos y se pagan hasta 20 dólares la hora. El anuncio, que no exigía experiencia previa, circuló en el grupo de Facebook “Bay Area Jobs” antes de ser retirado y generó apenas un par de comentarios, ninguno de los cuales advirtió lo singular de la propuesta.
La publicación correspondía a Dimensional, una compañía con sede en el barrio de Dogpatch, en San Francisco, un nombre que coincide de manera curiosa con el objeto de su búsqueda laboral. El puesto requería entre cuatro y seis horas de paseo diario, un tiempo mayor al que suele demandar la caminata con un perro convencional, según el texto del anuncio.
Los robots también se detienen a mitad de camino
El aviso advertía que los postulantes debían sentirse cómodos al “manejar de manera segura equipos que pesen alrededor de 15 kilos”. La razón es que los perros robot pueden sufrir sobrecalentamiento de su equipo y detenerse en plena calle, de forma similar a como un perro de carne y hueso se tira al suelo y se niega a avanzar. Cuando eso ocurre, el paseador debe cargar al animal mecánico de regreso a la oficina de la empresa.

articles.title: La falsa promesa del streaming gratis: así infectan tu celular las APKs de origen desconocido
articles.summary:
Más de un usuario busca en internet la forma de ver películas, series y eventos deportivos sin pagar una suscripción. Esa búsqueda los lleva a descargar aplicaciones no oficiales en formato APK, que prometen contenido gratuito pero en realidad funcionan como caballos de Troya diseñados para vulnerar dispositivos Android.
Al eludir los filtros de seguridad de las tiendas oficiales, estas apps exponen al usuario a un secuestro silencioso de su información personal y de los recursos de su teléfono.
Cómo se instalan las apps piratas y por qué son peligrosas
El primer paso de la infección ocurre antes de que el usuario toque un solo botón de reproducción. Para instalar estas aplicaciones, es necesario habilitar la opción de “instalar aplicaciones de orígenes desconocidos” en el sistema operativo.
Esa acción desactiva Google Play Protect, la principal barrera defensiva de Android. Sin esa supervisión, los ciberdelincuentes quedan en libertad de empaquetar la aplicación de streaming con código malicioso oculto dentro del mismo archivo.
Mientras la víctima mira un partido de fútbol o una película, la aplicación ejecuta procesos en segundo plano que le permiten tomar control del dispositivo.
Para lograrlo, suele solicitar permisos excesivos (acceso a contactos, SMS, almacenamiento o micrófono) que el usuario aprueba sin reparos con tal de acceder rápido al contenido.

articles.title: U.S. Manufacturing Activity Gains Momentum in October - EE Times
articles.summary:
Economic activity in the U.S. manufacturing sector expanded for the 10th consecutive month in October, driven by accelerating production and steady growth in new factory orders. Sustained industrial activity helped buffer the broader economy against persistent commodity inflation, trade tariffs, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
The Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported that its Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) registered 55.5% in October, up 1.0 percentage point from September’s 54.5%.
The reading marks 10 straight months of industrial expansion after a 10-month contraction and indicates that the overall U.S. economy grew for a 24th consecutive month. According to ISM’s economic modeling, an October PMI reading of 55.5% corresponds to a 2.7% annualized increase in real gross domestic product (GDP).
“In October, U.S. manufacturing activity remained in expansion territory,” said Susan Spence, chair of the ISM Manufacturing Business Survey Committee. “Of the five subindexes that make up the PMI, four (New Orders, Production, Supplier Deliveries, and Inventories) grew faster than the previous month, while employment growth slowed down by 0.3 percentage points.”
Production hits multi-year high while new orders accelerate

articles.title: Smugglers are reportedly soldering top-tier HBM onto deliberately useless processors to sneak it into China, and the trick isn't new
articles.summary:
Smugglers are reportedly soldering top-tier HBM onto deliberately useless processors to sneak it into China, and the trick isn't new
It's a complex, but old, trick
- Smugglers are reportedly pairing Samsung and SK hynix HBM with deliberately useless processors so the package passes export regulations as a low-end chip
- Shenzhen workshops then heat the packages, pry off the HBM3E, and sell it for about $4,000 a stack, mostly to Huawei customers
- The trick exploits a December 2024 BIS exclusion for co-packaged chips, but only "where the dominant function" is processing
Some of the most sought-after memory in the AI industry is reportedly reaching China attached to processors that were designed never to be used.
A new report from The Information claims smugglers are taking high-bandwidth memory (HBM) made by Samsung and SK hynix, packaging it alongside cheap, low-performance server chips, and exporting the combination as an ordinary processor with a CPU that nobody really wants.
Once the packages reach mainland China, workshops heat them until the solder gives way, pry off the memory stacks, and discard the processors.
A processor nobody wants paired to memory that has Chinese buyers lining up for more
The scheme reached a much wider audience when Chinese tech commentator AB Kuai.Dong summarized the report for his followers on X, describing the decoy chips as "clunky" processors and calling the arrangement a "compliant export.

articles.title: Reparan una lavadora en dos horas desde la casa, usando un celular y una IA
articles.summary:
Una lavadora de más de diez años encontró una segunda vida gracias a la inteligencia artificial. Su dueño, un usuario de Reddit identificado como McArhony, logró restaurar las funciones de control remoto que el fabricante había dejado de soportar, con la ayuda de Claude, el asistente de inteligencia artificial de Anthropic.
El equipo, un modelo Crystal Blue comprado hace más de una década, había quedado desconectado del ecosistema inteligente de la marca cuando Samsung discontinuó el soporte técnico para su sistema Smart Control. McArhony decidió no tirarlo a la basura y, en cambio, usó la IA para devolverle la conectividad perdida.
Qué le pasó a la lavadora antes del arreglo
En su momento, la lavadora representaba lo último en tecnología doméstica. Contaba con pantalla táctil, dosificación automática de detergente y control por internet mediante Wi-Fi, funciones que todavía hoy no son estándar en la mayoría de los electrodomésticos.
Con el paso de los años, la empresa decidió dejar de dar soporte a esa generación de equipos conectados. El dispensador automático de detergente dejó de funcionar y, en algún momento, fue necesario cambiar la placa madre de la máquina.
La obsolescencia programada ocurre cuando una empresa deja de actualizar o dar soporte técnico a un producto antiguo para incentivar el recambio por modelos nuevos. En este caso, la lavadora perdió su capacidad de conexión a internet, aunque seguía funcionando de manera mecánica sin inconvenientes.

articles.title: Can Small OSATs Compete in India’s Chip Boom? - EE Times
articles.summary:
India’s expanding outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) industry is creating opportunities for smaller, specialized packaging facilities alongside large, capital-intensive plants. Sahasra Semiconductors’ operating facility in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, represents one such entry point, with an investment of more than ₹1.5 billion (~$15.8 million), according to a May 2026 government announcement.
The question is whether smaller facilities can build commercially viable businesses by focusing on mature packaging technologies and specific product segments.
EE Times spoke with Nitin Dodia, semiconductor consultant and founder-director of Smart Fab Systems, who estimated that a facility focused on mature packaging technologies could be established with an investment of ₹1.5 billion (~$15.8 million) to ₹2 billion (~$21 million). He said the amount would depend on the products handled, equipment requirements, and operating expenditure.
Dodia’s estimate applies mainly to mature, non-advanced products with simpler processes. “Simple wire bonding or leadframe-based packaging is less capital-intensive,” he said.
Production volume drives capital expenditure (capex), Dodia said. A company such as Micron processes millions of chips every month and needs equipment built for those volumes. OSATs handling specialized products with mature technologies can start with much lower capex.

articles.title: Un chatbot a-t-il le droit de résumer un article de presse ? La justice européenne donne enfin une réponse
articles.summary:
L’avocat général de la Cour de justice de l'Union européenne a rendu ses conclusions dans la première affaire liée à l’IA générative. Selon lui, les réponses de chatbots comme Gemini peuvent porter atteinte au droit voisin des éditeurs de presse.
Demandez l'actualité du jour à un robot conversationnel d'intelligence artificielle, et il ira souvent piocher dans les articles des éditeurs de presse; C'est ce geste, devenu courant, que l'avocat général de la CJUE, Maciej Szpunar, vient de disséquer. Dans ses conclusions rendues le 3 novembre, dans le litige qui oppose le hongrois Like Company (opérateur de presse local) à Google, il estime que les réponses de Gemini peuvent porter atteinte au droit voisin des éditeurs lorsque l'IA contourne un mur payant pour lire un article, ou qu'elle en reprend la plume au point de dispenser de le lire. Sur l'entraînement des modèles, le ton est nettement plus clément, et pour Like Company elle-même, l'issue s'annonce compliquée.
Le droit voisin protège la plume, pas l’information
Gemini, l'assistant conversationnel de Google, repose sur des grands modèles de langage (LLM), que l'on peut décrire comme des réseaux de neurones entraînés sur d'immenses volumes de textes pour prédire, mot après mot, la suite la plus probable d'une phrase. Livrés à eux-mêmes, ils ont tendance à inventer des faits. D'où le recours à une technique baptisée RAG, pour « génération augmentée par récupération », ou grounding. articles.title: Pour le patron de l'IA chez Microsoft, en cas de signe de conscience chez l'IA, il faudra tout stopper
articles.summary:
La question de la conscience possible des modèles IA est abordée par un des acteurs les plus importants du secteur. Et pour lui, on ne doit surtout pas jouer aux apprentis sorciers.
Avec les progrès phénoménaux des modèles d'intelligence artificielle, la question d'une potentielle naissance d'une IA consciente est devenue aujourd'hui un problème sérieux - et non plus seulement de la science-fiction. Une telle perspective avait déjà été ainsi évoquée en début d'année par Anthropic, qui discutait même d'un éventuel statut moral pour Claude à l'avenir. Une autre voix aussi importante veut par contre elle par contre poser des barrières plus dures.
Si des traces de consciences apparaissent dans les IA, il faudra tout arrêter en urgence
Mustafa Suleyman est le patron de l'IA chez Microsoft. Et en tant que tel, il est toujours intéressant de lire ce qu'il a dire sur le sujet. Et alors que l'on entend beaucoup parler de régulation ou de ralentissement de l'IA, pour éviter une perte de contrôle, ce dernier lui va plus loin.
Dans un long message posté sur X, il a ainsi indiqué qu'en cas de découverte de traces de conscience dans l'IA, il ne fallait plus barguigner : la seule option serait de tout arrêter. « Si la conscience commençait à émerger au cours de l'entraînement, j'appellerais tout le monde à suspendre le développement de l'IA jusqu'à ce que nous puissions éliminer ces propriétés par conception » a-t-il ainsi plaidé.

articles.title: Por qué algunos videojuegos son tan difíciles de abandonar, según expertos
articles.summary:
Los videojuegos ya no dependen únicamente de la venta inicial para sostener sus ingresos. En numerosos títulos gratuitos o de actualización constante, el negocio se organiza alrededor de recompensas limitadas, monedas virtuales y compras dentro del juego que prolongan la participación y, en algunos casos, impulsan pagos sucesivos.
La discusión no parte de que jugar sea un problema en sí mismo. La cuestión es cómo ciertos diseños combinan la posibilidad de avanzar, la expectativa de una recompensa y la presión de no perder contenidos temporales. Esos recursos pueden influir tanto en el tiempo de juego como en las decisiones de gasto, especialmente cuando el costo real queda fragmentado entre distintas monedas y opciones de compra.
La Comisión Federal de Comercio de Estados Unidos, conocida como FTC, señaló que las cajas de recompensa son objetos virtuales cuyo contenido se conoce después de obtenerlos y que pueden comprarse o conseguirse al cumplir tareas dentro del juego. En su revisión sobre estas prácticas, la agencia recogió preocupaciones por los costos poco claros, la protección de menores y los mecanismos que podrían llevar a compras impulsivas.

L'origine des trous noirs supermassifs, et comment ils ont pu atteindre – parfois très rapidement – des masses de millions, voire milliards de fois celle de notre soleil, est un véritable casse-tête pour les astrophysiciens.
Et si nous avions déjà observé leurs berceaux sans vraiment nous en rendre compte ? C'est ce que propose une étude parue sur Astronomy & Astrophysics.
L'équipe de Viola Bocchi a modélisé des amas stellaires ultra-denses découverts par le télescope James-Webb et les chercheurs ont identifié des nurseries idéales où naîtraient les “graines lourdes” à l'origine de ces géants cosmiques.

Hard to focus
More than 50 years ago, the American economist Herbert A. Simon described his projection for the future of information circulation in a famous essay.

Simon argued that data and information is a resource that's consumed by the finite and limited attention of people, and that the more information is in circulation, the more strain that would place on people's focus and approach to absorbing the information out there.
These ideas laid the foundation for what has become the attention economy – a system in which human attention is traded as a valuable commodity that advertisers, platforms and websites compete to seize. articles.title: EU backs new Arctic subsea cable linking Greenland directly to Europe
articles.summary:
EU reveals plans for undersea cable straight to Greenland — and could bypass the US entirely to connect up the world
EU prioritizes direct Greenland cable to bypass US data routes
- EU commits $119 million to Greenland connectivity and the proposed Arctic cable
- Pan-Arctic Cable could eventually link Europe, Greenland, Canada, Japan and South Korea
- EU plans an Arctic Cable Hub to monitor and protect subsea infrastructure
The European Union is advancing an undersea communications proposal which would connect Greenland directly with Europe, avoiding American territory.
The Pan-Arctic Cable could later reach Canada, creating a northern passage for connections extending towards Japan and South Korea, the European Commission says, having identified the scheme as a priority in an Arctic policy paper released on October 20, 2026.
Installing and maintaining equipment in Arctic waters would require additional icebreaker support, increasing construction costs and complicating subsequent repairs significantly. However, there is already an agreement between European businesses, research institutions and Greenland’s telecommunications operator to further develop the proposal.
Europe backs a new Arctic communications route
The EU has committed $119 million (107 million euros) to Greenland’s secure communications infrastructure and the cable project, signalling its determination to establish the proposed connection.

articles.title: Ciberataque convirtió congeladores de supermercados en hornos a 49°C
articles.summary:
Freezers y refrigeradores de decenas de supermercados europeos alcanzaron temperaturas superiores a los 49℃ (120℉), luego de que hackers manipularan de forma remota los sistemas de control térmico y destruyeran productos perecederos.
Un ataque informático contra la infraestructura de refrigeración comercial afectó a cadenas minoristas en Suecia, Bélgica, Irlanda, Luxemburgo, los Países Bajos y Estonia, lo que expuso los riesgos de conectar equipos industriales a sistemas digitales accesibles de forma remota.
Hasta el momento, los investigadores no identificaron a los responsables de los incidentes. Ningún grupo de piratas informáticos se atribuyó esta ola de ataques ni la registrada en octubre contra supermercados franceses.
Cadenas minoristas de seis países reportaron fallas en sus refrigeradores
Los grupos belgas y luxemburgueses Ahold Delhaize y Colruyt informaron incidentes en su infraestructura de refrigeración. Colruyt registró cinco locales afectados, mientras que en Bélgica se sumaron 15 tiendas de Carrefour, según datos de la agencia Reuters. En Irlanda, los atacantes apuntaron contra 13 supermercados de la cadena SuperValu.
El sector minorista sueco también enfrentó problemas similares. Siete sucursales de Coop reportaron disrupciones en sus sistemas de refrigeración, mientras que la cadena ICA sufrió un incidente nocturno que afectó a un número limitado de locales.

articles.title: Shopify a déboursé 99 millions de dollars pour s'offrir shop.com
articles.summary:
Shopify vient de publier son rapport trimestriel. Avec une ligne de 99 millions de dollars, ce dernier semble très probablement confirmer le montant du rachat du nom de domaine Shop.com.
Market America Worldwide avait annoncé le 28 septembre avoir finalisé la vente du domaine SHOP.COM, sans donner de prix. Mais désormais, cela ne fait plus trop de doute.
99 millions de dollars dans une ligne comptable sans nom
Shopify a déposé hier son formulaire 10-Q, le rapport que les sociétés cotées aux États-Unis remettent chaque trimestre à la SEC, l’autorité des marchés financiers. Il couvre la période qui s’est terminée le 30 septembre. On y trouve 99 millions de dollars dépensés en « actifs incorporels », c’est-à-dire des biens sans existence physique, comme une marque ou un nom de domaine. Un an plus tôt, cette ligne était à zéro. Le communiqué de résultats affiche le même montant.
En septembre, le courtier Andrew Rosener parlait d’une transaction de 100 millions de dollars, une information alors non confirmée et non vérifiable. Selon Domain Name Wire, qui rapporte l’information, le document, même s’il ne nomme pas shop.com, semble confirmer la rumeur. Reste que la ligne en question est un total, pas une facture, et des frais ont pu s’ajouter de chaque côté. Le contrat n’a pas été publié.

articles.title: El secreto para liberar gigas en WhatsApp manteniendo todos los chats intactos
articles.summary:
El almacenamiento interno de un teléfono puede saturarse en cuestión de meses debido al uso constante de WhatsApp, ya que fotos, videos, audios y documentos se acumulan en chats y grupos hasta consumir varios gigabytes sin que el usuario lo note.
Ante esta situación, muchos recurren a apps externas o directamente a borrar conversaciones completas, con el riesgo de perder mensajes importantes en el proceso.
Sin embargo, existe una alternativa dentro de la propia aplicación que permite recuperar espacio sin eliminar el historial de texto: la herramienta de administración de almacenamiento, que identifica los archivos multimedia más pesados y permite borrarlos de forma selectiva, ya sea en toda la app o dentro de conversaciones puntuales, dejando los mensajes de cada chat completamente intactos.
Qué es la administración de almacenamiento y cómo funciona
Esta herramienta nativa muestra una barra gráfica que detalla con precisión cuánto espacio ocupan los archivos de WhatsApp en el teléfono, lo que permite tener una visión general del problema antes de actuar sobre él.
A partir de ese panorama, la aplicación ofrece la posibilidad de filtrar los contenidos por tamaño o por conversación específica, evitando así tener que revisar manualmente cada chat en busca de archivos pesados.
La opción “De más de 5 MB” agrupa automáticamente los videos y archivos más grandes de toda la aplicación, lo que facilita identificar en pocos segundos qué está consumiendo más memoria. También es posible …

Ce mois-ci, Prime Video dévoile une nouvelle série biopic à ses abonnés. The Greatest se penche sur la vie de Mohamed Ali et nous livre la première série de fiction autorisée sur le fameux boxeur qui proclamait être le meilleur de tous. Imaginée par Ben Watkins (Cross) et produite entre autres par Lonnie Ali, veuve du sportif, la série arrive le 4 novembre sur le service de streaming d'Amazon.

L'histoire de la série
Les moments marquants de la vie et de la carrière de Mohamed Ali, sur et hors du ring, hors des projecteurs. Le monde se souvient d'une icône, mais The Greatest parle d'un homme, d'un mari, d'un père, d'un frère et d'un fils.
Les débuts d'un champion
The Greatest aurait pu s'ouvrir sur la première fois que le jeune Cassius Marcellus Clay Jr. a mis des gants de boxe, ou sa première victoire sur le ring. articles.title: Des escrocs usurpent le numéro de commissariats pour piéger… les policiers : la DGPN impose le contre-appel
articles.summary:
Au bout du fil, un prétendu collègue d’un commissariat voisin réclame la levée d’une immobilisation de véhicule, sirène deux-tons en fond sonore et numéro officiel à l’écran. Pour déjouer ce type d’escroquerie, la direction de la police nationale ordonne à ses agents de raccrocher, puis de rappeler le service à un numéro trouvé par leurs soins.
Le spoofing consiste à faire apparaître sur l’écran de votre correspondant un numéro qui n’est pas le vôtre. Des escrocs emploient cette technique contre les commissariats pour se faire passer pour des policiers d’un autre service, et ils ont multiplié les appels au point que Louis Laugier, directeur général de la police nationale (DGPN), a envoyé un télégramme d’alerte à ses directeurs et chefs de service le 29 octobre. Dans ce document consulté par Le Parisien, le patron de la police interdit à ses agents de répondre à la demande d’un collègue sur la seule foi du numéro affiché.
Des levées d’immobilisation de véhicules extorquées par téléphone
Les escrocs connaissent le jargon de la maison. Ils prennent le ton pressé d’une urgence judiciaire et font parfois retentir une sirène deux-tons derrière eux pour rendre leur rôle crédible. « Tu peux me passer un gars aux fichiers ? articles.title: Apple permitirá usar Siri AI con la voz de otras aplicaciones para hacer reservas o leer documentos
articles.summary:
Apple permitirá que cualquier aplicación se conecte con Siri AI, la nueva versión de su asistente de voz. La empresa lo anunció el 3 de noviembre con las versiones beta 27.3 de sus sistemas operativos. Es una vista previa para desarrolladores: el público todavía no puede usarla.
Hasta ahora, las funciones más avanzadas del asistente funcionaban sobre todo con las aplicaciones de Apple. Con esta apertura, una app de terceros podrá ofrecer sus contenidos y acciones a Siri AI mediante App Intents, la herramienta con la que los desarrolladores describen lo que hace su aplicación.
Según Apple, el usuario podrá pedir en sus propias palabras que la app compruebe un envío, reserve una mesa o haga un pedido. El asistente se apoya en tres capacidades: el contexto personal del usuario, el reconocimiento de lo que hay en pantalla y la comprensión del lenguaje natural.
Los desarrolladores también podrán crear “habilidades”, un recurso para enseñar a Siri AI a combinar varias acciones en una sola petición. La compañía añadió que el asistente puede mostrar cualquier elemento del índice semántico de Spotlight, el buscador del sistema, y no solo los que encajan en un formato predefinido.
Pedir un viaje sin nombrar la aplicación
La documentación de Apple, citada por The Verge, indica que el usuario no tendrá que decir el nombre de la app si esta está en primer plano, si tiene una Live Activity (aviso en tiempo real en la pantalla de bloqueo) o si la conversación con Siri AI ya trata de ella.
